down_1m.text: S&P 500 closes lower 21 trading days (about 1 month) from now

dd5_1m.text: S&P 500 closes at least 5% below today's close at some point in the next 21 trading days

down_3m.text: S&P 500 closes lower 63 trading days (about 3 months) from now

dd10_3m.text: S&P 500 closes at least 10% below today's close at some point in the next 63 trading days

down_12m.text: S&P 500 closes lower 252 trading days (about 12 months) from now

dd10_12m.text: S&P 500 closes at least 10% below today's close at some point in the next 252 trading days

dd20_12m.text: S&P 500 closes at least 20% below today's close at some point in the next 252 trading days

cape_10y_real_return.note: in-sample OLS on overlapping windows; effective independent samples ~ n/120

rules.definition: 3m bill 12m change > +0.25 pt, or 10y yield 12m change > +0.5 pt
CPI yoy > 3% and its 12m change > +0.5 pt
NVDA >= 20% below 52w high while S&P within 10% of its 52w high (current only)
RSP 12m return minus SPY 12m return <= -5 pt
HYG >= 7% below 52w high, or HY OAS > 5% (FRED)
